content: {"like": ["The documentary \"Tour of the Inferno\" is well worth the additional watch for this PLATOON SPECIAL EDITION.", "The humor of John C McGinley's impromptu squinting, blinking imitation of Director Stone was quite humorous.", "PLATOON still seems to hold up today as a gritty, realistic portrayal of the Vietnam war, regarded as one of the best for good reason.", "The doc with all the behind-the-scenes interview stories is good, and mixing in some \"real\" Vietnam footage in effective measure.", "Director Stone's good, \"mannered\" informative commentary is appreciated even if repetitious."], "dislike": []}
